questions.prompt: Name a type of mushroom or other fungus.
questions.scope: Recognized named fungi, mushroom kinds, molds, mildews and yeasts count. Common or scientific names are accepted. Bacteria, viruses and modern non-fungal slime/water molds do not count; diseases alone are not organism names.
questions.rationale: One independently chosen, recognizable whole category. Full source descendants are reconciled by word sense; explicit holds remove content, components, fantasy individuals and misleading taxonomy entries. Modern common answers and actual public synonyms fill dictionary omissions. No property joins, object-use combinations or source subsections create extra questions.
